mechanics.claim: Ahri dashes to a location then fires bolts to up to 3 nearby visible enemies, each a separate damage instance.
mechanics.quote: dashes to the target location and then fires essence bolts to up to 3 nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies, each dealing {{as|magic damage}}

mechanics.claim: Each cast counts as a separate ability activation, triggering on-cast effects each time.
mechanics.quote: Each cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: Damage is recalculated at the moment of firing based on Ahri's current stats, not locked in at cast.
mechanics.quote: This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's current stats and changes dynamically.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown starts after the first cast and refreshes whenever a recast is gained.
mechanics.quote: Starts after first cast, and refreshes upon gaining recasts

mechanics.claim: Bolts fail to fire if Ahri dies while dashing (unless resurrected), but do fire if the dash is interrupted by other means.
mechanics.quote: The bolts do not fire if '''Ahri''' dies while {{tip|dash|dashing}}, unless she was saved by {{tip|resurrection}}.
